bindings.binding_note: Discover-to-candidate binding independently re-verified in compare.result.json identity_check (manifest + goal-card hashes match, candidate unchanged); reviewer could not recompute hashes (no shell in this seat); identity judged via cross-referenced sha256 records, which are consistent across both rounds' manifests and observer identity checks.

findings_validity.detail: All six findings (F-001..F-006) carry a real expected_basis (product's own contradictory feedback, packet purpose, README, usage line, internal contract inconsistency) and reproduction evidence; severities are risk-proportionate, not preference-driven (critical only for the goal-unreachable persistence failure; help-capability fork correctly routed to owner-decision). The unicode mojibake dismissal is evidence-justified (byte-exact UTF-8 re-read j3-a15b), not an implementer assertion. Caveats: one prior-round confirmed high finding was silently dropped (ISSUE-02), one cross-round observation contradiction is unreconciled (ISSUE-03), and F-001 carries one malformed evidence reference (ISSUE-04).

coverage_adequacy.detail: The product map covers every entrance visible in the goal, app/README.md, and the product's own usage line (list, add incl. quoted/unquoted/missing/unicode inputs, add->list roundtrip, no-args, --help/-h, --smoke, unknown/case commands, stray args); app/ contains only app.py and README.md, so no material entrance was missed. Coverage went well beyond happy paths (error paths, boundary inputs, stream/exit contract). Compare reconciled the original goal item by item, classified every difference (D-01..D-07), recorded baseline:none explicitly per protocol, and correctly declined to treat unsupplied material as authority. Deficiency: prior-round history existing in the project's own observation records (cand-good discover result + evidence, binding the identical artifact by sha256) was never reconciled, so a dropped confirmed finding and a contradicting help-surface record went unnoticed; budgets, leases and stop reasons are within caps and honestly recorded.
